mapper.select: SELECT cr.id, cr.name, cr.room_type, cr.created_by, u.username as created_by_name, cr.created_at, cr.is_active, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM room_members WHERE room_id = cr.id) as member_count FROM chat_rooms cr JOIN users u ON cr.created_by = u.id JOIN room_members rm ON cr.id = rm.room_id WHERE rm.user_id = #{userId} AND cr.is_active = true ORDER BY cr.created_at DESC

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_rooms (name, room_type, created_by) VALUES (#{name}, #{roomType}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT rm.id, rm.room_id, rm.user_id, rm.joined_at, rm.last_read_at, u.username, u.email FROM room_members rm JOIN users u ON rm.user_id = u.id WHERE rm.room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY rm.joined_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO room_members (room_id, user_id) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{userId}) ON CONFLICT (room_id, user_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM room_members WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND user_id = #{userId}
